# TOGAF Artifact Creation Guidelines

**← Back to [EAP Home](../../../../README.md) • [Work Templates](../../README.md) • [Artifacts](./README.md)**

This document governs how general-purpose (non-security) TOGAF-aligned architecture artifacts are authored using the templates in this directory. It is the authoritative reference for both **human architects** and **AI agents** producing ABBs, RADs, SBBs, and BDD Specifications.

For **security-specific** TOGAF artifacts, see [security-template-creation-guidelines.md](./security-template-creation-guidelines.md).

[resources/work-templates/assets/artifacts/togaf-artifact-creation-guidelines.md#10-overview]

## 1.0 Overview

These templates produce TOGAF-aligned architecture artifacts for use across all non-security domains in the Gainwell Enterprise Architecture Program. They follow the TOGAF Architecture Development Method (ADM) phase sequence from Architecture Vision (Phase A) through Migration Planning (Phase F), with BDD Specifications bridging Phase C–E.

**Domain routing**: Content produced from these templates is stored in the domain-appropriate subdirectory of `strategy/guidance/`:

| Domain | Storage Path |
|---|---|
| Application | `strategy/guidance/application/` |
| Business | `strategy/guidance/` *(top-level or business subdirectory)* |
| Information / Data | `strategy/guidance/` |
| Infrastructure | `strategy/guidance/infrastructure/` |
| Technology | `strategy/guidance/technology/` |
| ITSM / Operations | `strategy/guidance/` |
| Governance | `strategy/guidance/governance/` |

**Security domain exception**: Security artifacts use dedicated templates and live exclusively in `strategy/guidance/security/`. See [security-template-creation-guidelines.md](./security-template-creation-guidelines.md).

[resources/work-templates/assets/artifacts/togaf-artifact-creation-guidelines.md#20-document-chain-and-authoring-order]

## 2.0 Document Chain and Authoring Order

TOGAF artifacts form a **strictly ordered dependency chain**. Do not begin authoring a document until all its prerequisites exist at `draft` status or higher.
page_texts.5:
[resources/work-templates/assets/artifacts/togaf-artifact-creation-guidelines.md#mandatory-authoring-order]

### Mandatory Authoring Order

```
Phase A      Architecture Vision
Phase B      Capability Descriptions
Phase B      Capability Map
Phase B–D    Composite ABB              (one per capability domain)
Phase B–D    Component ABBs             (one per L2 capability)
Phase B–D    ABB Catalog                (after all Component ABBs are drafted)
Phase C–D    Reference Architecture (RAD)  (one per Component ABB)
Phase C–E    BDD Specification          (one per Component ABB minimum)
Phase E–F    Solution Building Block (SBB) (one per product realization)
```
page_texts.6:
[resources/work-templates/assets/artifacts/togaf-artifact-creation-guidelines.md#chain-diagram]

### Chain Diagram

```
GUID-<DOMAIN>-<CAP>-VISION-0.D.NN             [Phase A  — Architecture Vision]
│
├── GUID-<DOMAIN>-<CAP>-CAP-DESC-0.D.NN        [Phase A–B — Capability Descriptions]
│
├── GUID-<DOMAIN>-<CAP>-CAP-MAP-0.D.NN         [Phase B   — Capability Map]
│
├── GUID-<DOMAIN>-<CAP>-ABB-1.D.NN             [Phase B–D — Composite ABB]
│   │
│   ├── GUID-<DOMAIN>-<CAP>-<TYPE>-2.D.01      [Phase B–D — Component ABB #1]
│   │   ├── GUID-<DOMAIN>-<CAP>-<TYPE>-RAD-3.D.01    [Phase C–D — RAD]
│   │   │   └── GUID-<DOMAIN>-<CAP>-<TYPE>-BDD-3.5.D.01  [Phase C–E — BDD Spec] ← NEW
│   │   └── GUID-<DOMAIN>-<CAP>-<TYPE>-SBB-4.D.01    [Phase E–F — SBB]
│   │
│   ├── GUID-<DOMAIN>-<CAP>-<TYPE>-2.D.02      [Phase B–D — Component ABB #2]
│   │   ├── GUID-<DOMAIN>-<CAP>-<TYPE>-RAD-3.D.02
│   │   │   └── GUID-<DOMAIN>-<CAP>-<TYPE>-BDD-3.5.D.02
│   │   └── GUID-<DOMAIN>-<CAP>-<TYPE>-SBB-4.D.02
│   │
│   └── ...
│
└── GUID-<DOMAIN>-<CAP>-ABB-MATRIX-2.D.NN     [Phase B–D — ABB Catalog]
```
page_texts.7:
[resources/work-templates/assets/artifacts/togaf-artifact-creation-guidelines.md#hard-prerequisites]

### Hard Prerequisites

| Artifact | Requires These to Exist First |
|---|---|
| Capability Descriptions | Architecture Vision |
| Capability Map | Architecture Vision, Capability Descriptions |
| Composite ABB | Architecture Vision, Capability Map |
| Component ABB | Architecture Vision, Composite ABB |
| ABB Catalog | Architecture Vision, Composite ABB, all Component ABBs for the domain |
| Reference Architecture (RAD) | Component ABB it pairs with |
| BDD Specification | Component ABB AND Reference Architecture it derives from |
| Solution Building Block (SBB) | Component ABB, Reference Architecture, and BDD Specification it realizes |

> **AI authoring agents**: Before generating any artifact, verify prerequisites exist in the repository. If the Architecture Vision for the domain does not exist, start there — do not generate a Component ABB without a parent Vision.

[resources/work-templates/assets/artifacts/togaf-artifact-creation-guidelines.md#30-guid-numbering-scheme]

## 3.0 GUID Numbering Scheme

Every TOGAF artifact has a globally unique identifier (GUID) that encodes its domain, capability, type, and position in the ADM phase chain.
page_texts.9:
[resources/work-templates/assets/artifacts/togaf-artifact-creation-guidelines.md#format]

### Format

```
GUID-<DOMAIN>-<CAP>-<TYPE>-<PHASE>.<MINOR>.<PATCH>
```

| Component | Description | Examples |
|---|---|---|
| `GUID` | Literal prefix | `GUID` |
| `<DOMAIN>` | Architecture domain code (see §4.0) | `APP`, `BIZ`, `INF`, `DAT`, `TEC`, `OPS`, `GOV` |
| `<CAP>` | Capability area abbreviation (2–6 uppercase letters) | `AUTH`, `INTG`, `NOTIF`, `RPTS` |
| `<TYPE>` | Artifact type code (see table below) | `ABB`, `RAD`, `BDD`, `SBB`, `VISION` |
| `<PHASE>` | ADM phase position (see table below) | `0`, `1`, `2`, `3`, `3.5`, `4` |
| `<MINOR>` | Domain index (D = `1` for initial; increment for revisions) | `1`, `2` |
| `<PATCH>` | Sequence number within the phase position (zero-padded) | `01`, `02`, `03` |
page_texts.10:
[resources/work-templates/assets/artifacts/togaf-artifact-creation-guidelines.md#phase-position-codes]

### Phase Position Codes

| Code | Artifact | TOGAF ADM Phase |
|---|---|---|
| `0` | Vision, Capability Descriptions, Capability Map | Phase A–B |
| `1` | Composite ABB | Phase B–D |
| `2` | Component ABB, ABB Catalog (`MATRIX`) | Phase B–D |
| `3` | Reference Architecture (RAD) | Phase C–D |
| `3.5` | BDD Specification | Phase C–E |
| `4` | Solution Building Block (SBB) | Phase E–F |
page_texts.11:
[resources/work-templates/assets/artifacts/togaf-artifact-creation-guidelines.md#type-codes]

### Type Codes

| Code | Artifact | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| `VISION` | Architecture Vision | Used as the TYPE component for Vision documents |
| `CAP-DESC` | Capability Descriptions | Used as the TYPE component |
| `CAP-MAP` | Capability Map | Used as the TYPE component |
| `ABB` | Composite Architecture Building Block | Used as the TYPE component for **Composite ABBs only** (phase 1.x) |
| `<SUBTYPE>` | Component Architecture Building Block | Component ABBs do **not** use `ABB` as a type code — they use a sub-capability abbreviation (e.g., `AUTHZ`, `AUTHN`, `ENCRYPT`) as the TYPE. The phase position `2.x` identifies it as a Component ABB. |
| `ABB-MATRIX` | ABB Catalog (traceability matrix) | Used as the TYPE component |
| `RAD` | Reference Architecture Document | Appended **after** the sub-capability TYPE: `<SUBTYPE>-RAD` |
| `BDD` | BDD Specification | Appended **after** the sub-capability TYPE: `<SUBTYPE>-BDD` |
| `SBB` | Solution Building Block | Appended **after** the sub-capability TYPE: `<SUBTYPE>-SBB` |

> **Component ABB GUID pattern**: `GUID-<DOMAIN>-<CAP>-<SUBTYPE>-<PHASE>.<MINOR>.<PATCH>` — note there is **no** `ABB` qualifier. The phase number `2.x` is the sole indicator that this is a Component ABB.
>
> **RAD / BDD / SBB GUID pattern**: `GUID-<DOMAIN>-<CAP>-<SUBTYPE>-<ARTIFACT>-<PHASE>.<MINOR>.<PATCH>` — both the sub-capability TYPE and the artifact qualifier (`RAD`, `BDD`, `SBB`) appear before the phase number.
page_texts.12:
[resources/work-templates/assets/artifacts/togaf-artifact-creation-guidelines.md#guid-examples]

### GUID Examples

```
GUID-APP-AUTH-VISION-0.1.01        Application domain, Auth capability, Architecture Vision
GUID-APP-AUTH-ABB-1.1.01           Application domain, Auth capability, Composite ABB
GUID-APP-AUTH-AUTHZ-2.1.01         Application domain, Auth capability, Authorization Component ABB
GUID-APP-AUTH-AUTHZ-RAD-3.1.01     Application domain, Auth capability, Authorization RAD
GUID-APP-AUTH-AUTHZ-BDD-3.5.1.01   Application domain, Auth capability, Authorization BDD Specification
GUID-APP-AUTH-AUTHZ-SBB-4.1.01     Application domain, Auth capability, Authorization SBB (specific product)
GUID-INF-NETW-VISION-0.1.01        Infrastructure domain, Networking capability, Architecture Vision
GUID-BIZ-ONBRD-ABB-1.1.01          Business domain, Onboarding capability, Composite ABB
```

[resources/work-templates/assets/artifacts/togaf-artifact-creation-guidelines.md#50-directory-layout]

## 5.0 Directory Layout

Artifacts produced from these templates are stored in a domain/capability folder structure under `strategy/guidance/`:

```
strategy/guidance/
└── <domain>/
    └── <capability-folder>/               # e.g., authentication/, notification/
        ├── <GUID>-vision.md               # Architecture Vision (Phase A)
        ├── <GUID>-cap-desc.md             # Capability Descriptions (Phase A–B)
        ├── <GUID>-cap-map.md              # Capability Map (Phase B)
        ├── <GUID>-abb.md                  # Composite ABB (Phase B–D)
        ├── <GUID>-abb-matrix.md           # ABB Catalog (Phase B–D)
        ├── <component-1>/
        │   ├── <GUID>-<type>-abb.md       # Component ABB (Phase B–D)
        │   ├── ref-arch/
        │   │   └── <GUID>-<type>-rad.md   # Reference Architecture (Phase C–D)
        │   ├── bdd/
        │   │   └── <GUID>-<type>-bdd.md   # BDD Specification (Phase C–E)
        │   │   └── features/              # Feature files (.feature) — owned by QA/dev
        │   └── sbbs/
        │       └── <GUID>-<type>-sbb.md   # Solution Building Block (Phase E–F)
        └── <component-2>/
            └── ...
```
page_texts.15:
[resources/work-templates/assets/artifacts/togaf-artifact-creation-guidelines.md#file-naming-convention]

### File Naming Convention

Use lowercase kebab-case. Include the abbreviated GUID at the start of the filename:

```
guid-app-auth-vision-0.1.01-authentication-vision.md
guid-app-auth-abb-1.1.01-authentication-composite-abb.md
guid-app-auth-authz-2.1.01-authorization-component-abb.md
guid-app-auth-authz-rad-3.1.01-authorization-reference-architecture.md
guid-app-auth-authz-bdd-3.5.1.01-authorization-bdd-specification.md
guid-app-auth-authz-sbb-4.1.01-authorization-sbb-okta.md
```

## 6.0 Template Index

| Artifact | Template File | Use When |

| Architecture Vision | *(pending)* | Starting a new capability domain from scratch |
| Composite ABB | [abb-definition-template.md](./abb-definition-template.md) | Defining the parent container for a capability domain |

| Solution Building Block (SBB) | [sbb-template.md](./sbb-template.md) | Documenting a specific product/platform realization of an ABB |

[resources/work-templates/assets/artifacts/togaf-artifact-creation-guidelines.md#70-metadata-field-reference]

## 7.0 Metadata Field Reference

All artifacts include a YAML metadata block. Required fields per artifact type:
page_texts.18:
[resources/work-templates/assets/artifacts/togaf-artifact-creation-guidelines.md#common-fields-all-artifacts]

### Common Fields (all artifacts)

| Field | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `guidance_id` | **Yes** | Full GUID per §3.0 scheme |
| `guidance_name` | **Yes** | Human-readable name |
| `guidance_type` | **Yes** | Artifact type slug (see Type Codes in §3.0) |
| `adm_phase` | **Yes** | TOGAF ADM phase(s) this artifact belongs to |
| `category` | **Yes** | Domain code (lowercase) — `application`, `business`, `infrastructure`, etc. |
| `version` | **Yes** | Semantic version (`0.1.0` for initial draft) |
| `status` | **Yes** | One of: `draft`, `in-review`, `approved`, `deprecated` |
| `applicability` | **Yes** | `enterprise`, `domain`, `project`, or `component` |
| `tags` | **Yes** | Array of lowercase tags including domain, capability, and artifact type |
| `author` | **Yes** | Author name |
page_texts.19:
[resources/work-templates/assets/artifacts/togaf-artifact-creation-guidelines.md#abb-specific-fields]

### ABB-Specific Fields

| Field | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `abb_type` | **Yes** | `composite` or `component` |
| `parent_abb` | Component only | GUID of the parent Composite ABB |
| `parent_vision` | **Yes** | GUID of the Architecture Vision |
| `child_abbs` | Composite only | Array of child Component ABB GUIDs |
| `realized_by_sbbs` | **Yes** | Set to `[]` initially — populated when SBBs are produced |
| `paired_rad` | Component only | GUID of the paired RAD |
| `paired_bdd` | Component only | GUID of the paired BDD Specification — set when the BDD Spec is authored |
page_texts.20:
[resources/work-templates/assets/artifacts/togaf-artifact-creation-guidelines.md#rad-specific-fields]

### RAD-Specific Fields

| Field | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `rad_type` | **Yes** | `composite` or `component` |
| `paired_abb` | **Yes** | GUID of the Component ABB this RAD pairs with |
| `parent_abb` | **Yes** | GUID of the Composite ABB |
| `parent_vision` | **Yes** | GUID of the Architecture Vision |
page_texts.21:
[resources/work-templates/assets/artifacts/togaf-artifact-creation-guidelines.md#bdd-specification-specific-fields]

### BDD Specification-Specific Fields

| Field | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `bdd_type` | **Yes** | `component` (BDD Specs are always Component-level) |
| `source_abb` | **Yes** | GUID of the Component ABB these scenarios derive from |
| `source_rad` | **Yes** | GUID of the paired RAD |
| `parent_vision` | **Yes** | GUID of the Architecture Vision |
| `scenario_count` | **Yes** | Total number of Given/When/Then scenarios in this document |
| `coverage` | **Yes** | Array of ABB SHALL requirement IDs covered by scenarios |
page_texts.22:
[resources/work-templates/assets/artifacts/togaf-artifact-creation-guidelines.md#sbb-specific-fields]

### SBB-Specific Fields

| Field | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `sbb_type` | **Yes** | `composite` or `component` |
| `realized_abb` | **Yes** | GUID of the Component ABB this SBB realizes |
| `paired_rad` | **Yes** | GUID of the paired RAD |
| `validates_bdd` | **Yes** | GUID of the BDD Specification this SBB is evaluated against |

## 8.0 Status Lifecycle

| Status | Meaning | Who Sets It |
|---|---|---|
| `draft` | Initial authoring in progress; not yet peer-reviewed | Author |
| `in-review` | Submitted for peer review; not yet approved | Author |
| `approved` | Reviewed and signed off by the appropriate authority | Enterprise Architect or designated reviewer |
| `deprecated` | Superseded by a newer version or no longer applicable | Enterprise Architect |

**Approval authority:**

| Artifact | Approval Authority |
|---|---|
| Architecture Vision | Enterprise Architecture Lead |
| Composite/Component ABB | Enterprise Architect |
| RAD | Enterprise Architect + domain SME |
| BDD Specification | Solution Architect + BA + QA Lead |
| SBB | Enterprise Architect + Solution Architect |

[resources/work-templates/assets/artifacts/togaf-artifact-creation-guidelines.md#90-file-naming-conventions]

## 9.0 File Naming Conventions

- Use **lowercase kebab-case** for all filenames
- Include the full abbreviated GUID as the filename prefix
- Use the artifact type as a suffix segment: `-vision`, `-abb`, `-rad`, `-bdd`, `-sbb`
- For SBBs: append the product abbreviation at the end (e.g., `-sbb-okta`, `-sbb-keycloak`)

**Examples:**

```
guid-app-auth-vision-0.1.01-authentication-vision.md
guid-app-auth-abb-1.1.01-authentication-composite-abb.md
guid-app-auth-authz-2.1.01-authorization-component-abb.md
guid-app-auth-authz-rad-3.1.01-authorization-rad.md
guid-app-auth-authz-bdd-3.5.1.01-authorization-bdd-specification.md
guid-app-auth-authz-sbb-4.1.01-authorization-sbb-keycloak.md
```

[resources/work-templates/assets/artifacts/togaf-artifact-creation-guidelines.md#110-pre-commit-authoring-checklist]

## 11.0 Pre-Commit Authoring Checklist

Before committing any TOGAF artifact, verify:

**All artifacts:**
- [ ] GUID follows the format in §3.0 and is unique within the repository
- [ ] YAML metadata block is complete with all required fields per §7.0
- [ ] All placeholder text (`<Name>`, `<GUID>`, `<Author>`) has been replaced
- [ ] Status is set to `draft` (minimum)
- [ ] All prerequisite artifacts exist at `draft` status or higher (see §2.0)
- [ ] All cross-references use relative paths and point to existing files
- [ ] No specific products, vendors, or pricing information in ABBs or RADs
- [ ] No new normative requirements introduced (standards live in `standards/`)

**ABBs:**
- [ ] Every SHALL/SHOULD requirement is uniquely identifiable (numbered or labeled)
- [ ] Scope "Out of Scope" items reference the sibling ABB that owns them
- [ ] `realized_by_sbbs` is set to `[]` (populated only when SBBs exist)

**RADs:**
- [ ] Architecture diagrams use logical names — no vendor logos or product names
- [ ] "Informative Content Notice" retained at top of document
- [ ] Control Responsibility Matrix includes all relevant teams

**BDD Specifications:**
- [ ] Every ABB SHALL requirement maps to at least one scenario
- [ ] Every scenario follows `Given / When / Then` structure
- [ ] Negative/edge case scenarios are included
- [ ] Security-relevant scenarios are tagged `@security`
- [ ] No implementation-specific details in Phase C–E BDD Specs
- [ ] `coverage` metadata field lists all ABB SHALL IDs covered

**SBBs:**
- [ ] `validates_bdd` field references the BDD Specification
- [ ] Capability Delivery Matrix addresses every ABB SHALL
- [ ] Known gaps between product capability and ABB SHALLs are documented
- [ ] Product version is the minimum supported version, not a specific pinned version
